headline_insights: OAuth2 (76.0%) and API Keys (65.0%) cover 94.0% of the 100 platforms (94/100), with Personal/Access Tokens at 25.0% and Basic Auth at 8.0%.

Category gating polarization (76.0% frictionless overall): Developer, Infra and Data platforms (100.0% self-serve) and Productivity and Project Management (100.0% self-serve) lead open onboarding, whereas AI, Research and Media-native (50.0% gated) and Finance and Fintech (50.0% gated) show the highest gating friction.

Primary non-technical friction: 28/100 (28.0%) require administrative approval (21 OAuth app review + 7 enterprise/sales contracts), alongside 7 (7.0%) blocked without a public API -- leaving 86/100 (86.0%) Composio-viable today.
MCP Greenfield Opportunity: 30/100 (30.0%) have a verified official or community MCP server, leaving 70/100 (70.0%) as greenfield opportunities for Composio.

Local CLI & Open-Source Tools (6 apps, e.g., Twenty, WooCommerce, Magento (Adobe Commerce)) require a distinct local MCP subprocess paradigm (stdio/containerized workers) rather than cloud HTTP webhooks.
